Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment 
inspection list I1, which must be carried out 
every 3 months as indicated by M3 in the title 
block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdo 
Abdo El Hendawy, tested by eng. Abdel Qader Fath Alla at 02 April 2003 on 
Boiler no. 4 and revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir Abdel Gilel, 
accepted by general director eng. Sobhy Mohamed El Bakry and approved by eng. 
Moneer Mohamed El Wakeel Head Sector of Demiatta PS.
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence 
 (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Wear safety 
 helmet, shoes.
Be sure the seal air blower is stopped
Disconnect the power supply of the seal air fan motor
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Tools and Equipment
Hex. keys, Alin kit,
Screw driver,
New grease, Grease Gun
Work to be Carried Out
Inject 
 new grease into both bearings by a grease gun until the used grease comes out 
 of the side as suitable bearing grease such as (comparable R3)
Check the coupling flexible intermediate ring, change it if necessary.
